game.title: Los Angeles Rams at Las Vegas Raiders

lede: Los Angeles Rams carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#4 in EPA per play), while Las Vegas Raiders owns the more favourable defensive matchup (#13 in EPA allowed per play).
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Las Vegas Raiders +5.0 with a fair total of 49.5 — inside a touchdown, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Los Angeles Rams pass offence vs Las Vegas Raiders pass defence, which sits +0.233 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is availability: NFL injury report — not loaded in this session.
